name: Hug Tower & TROLL Traps
desc:
Grab your friends, toss them into the lava, and unleash chaos!
💣 Launch players from cannons and discover crazy traps!
🏆 Climb the tower, collect rewards, and unlock new items and transport animations!
Can you reach the top without getting thrown off? 🔥

llm.loop: climb a tower obby -> grab friends and throw them into lava or traps, launch from cannons -> reach the top for rewards -> unlock items and transport animations
llm.objectives: reach the top of the tower without getting thrown off while trolling others
llm.progression: tower stages, rewards, items and carry animations, badges
llm.instructions: grab friends, toss them into lava, launch players from cannons, climb the tower and collect rewards
unique: hug/carry-and-throw trolling combined with a tower obby
llm.thumbnails: avatar carrying a crying player toward a crocodile mouth, HUG! text, lava, 'PRO' firing 'NOOB' from a golden cannon
llm.video: 1 page video; content not visible in the sheet
llm.complexity_notes: obby tower, player grab/throw physics, cannons and trap props, troll commands
